highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands platform coverage and fixes deployment and rendering failures.
highlights_body: The stable release rolls up the 3.119.3 preview, including Linux ARM64 and AOT fixes, alongside new Gtk4, Tizen, and Linux Bionic support.

breaking.title: Blazor _Imports is no longer a component
breaking.body: The generated Blazor _Imports type no longer derives from ComponentBase or implements component interfaces. Do not reference it as a component; use application components for rendering behavior.

bullets.lead: New Gtk4, Linux Bionic, and Tizen support
bullets.detail: Adds Gtk4 views, Linux Bionic native assets, and Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds.

bullets.lead: .NET Framework and legacy target support improved
bullets.detail: Adds net48 validation and C# 13 compatibility for legacy target frameworks.
Fixes Linux ARM64 startup, GTK4 Cairo assertions, missing Direct3D 12 handling, and MAUI Android SKGLView rendering after tab changes.
Includes libpng updates and native binary hardening inherited from the 3.119.3 preview.

preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 added Gtk4, Linux Bionic, Tizen, and deployment fixes.
preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The rolled-up preview introduced Linux ARM64 and AOT servicing fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Carries the HarfBuzzSharp updates and native hardening from the 3.119 servicing line.
